caret.description: where the caret stands, as an offset into what is typed

from.description: where the word being completed starts

to.description: where the word being completed ends

cands.description: what can replace that word, each its text as it reads once taken and the kind of thing it is (@yaks/query complete)

pick.description: which of cands is picked, -1 for none: what is typed already reads whole

filter.description: a query being typed, in a page's own graph: the caret, and what can come next there; its list is open while cands has any. What is typed is the person's draft, kept where the host says (its drafts)
